usedFor: Fillout collects form answers, and HubSpot stores the person with “Create Contact” or “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission” in Fillout, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A form submission is often the first sign of a buyer, so the deal opens straight from it.

watchOut: “Create Contact” needs an email, so make sure the form asks for one.
